newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PMH ups stake in associate company.
newsitem.headline: PMH ups stake in associate company.

text.p: Property developer Pan Malayan Holdings Ltd (PMH) said in a statement on Tuesday it has signed agreements to purchase a total of 10.75 million shares in associated company Sin Lee Investment Holdings Ltd.
The agreements are with two existing shareholders -- Bara Pte Ltd and Mr Alwi Maruli -- and will take PMH's stake in Sin Lee to 62.5 percent from 35.6 percent.
The purchase price of Singapore $10.75 million will be financed by proceeds from PMH's three-for-two rights issue which PMH received in July, 1996.
PMH said the acquisition was not expected to have any material impact on its net tangible assets and earnings per stock.
